props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Leave it out for an icon-only button.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Label shown after copying. Only used when children is set.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: How long the copied state stays, in milliseconds.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the text was copied.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the button.
